Row.Text: World Bank loan approved
You got {2_Amount : number #} [ICON_Gold] from the World Bank as loan #{1_LoanID} (loan numbers count across all civs). Payments show in the Bank panel.
Payment missed on loan #{1_LoanID}

You couldn't cover {4_Amount : number #} [ICON_Gold] on World Bank loan #{1_LoanID} ({2_Principal : number #} [ICON_Gold], {3_Turns : number #} turns). That part is now in arrears and picks up a fee each turn.
Default warning: loan #{1_LoanID}

World Bank loan #{1_LoanID} ({2_Principal : number #} [ICON_Gold], {3_Turns : number #} turns) goes into default after {4_Left : number #} more turns in arrears. Every turn it's behind counts, even if you catch up in between.
Loan #{1_LoanID} is in default

World Bank loan #{1_LoanID} ({2_Principal : number #} [ICON_Gold], {3_Turns : number #} turns) is in default. Until all your arrears are paid, the bank takes part of your income each turn and your cities take penalties.
Default got worse: loan #{1_LoanID}
World Bank loan #{1_LoanID} ({2_Principal : number #} [ICON_Gold], {3_Turns : number #} turns) is still in default, so the penalties are heavier now and the bank takes more of your income.
Out of default

Your arrears are paid, so the default on World Bank loan #{1_LoanID} ({2_Principal : number #} [ICON_Gold], {3_Turns : number #} turns) is over and the penalties are gone. Your credit stays scarred for a while.
Loan restructured
World Bank loan #{2_OldLoanID} is now loan #{1_LoanID} with a longer schedule. It cost {3_Favor : number #} [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor.
Debt relief granted
You hit your relief milestone, so the World Bank forgave {1_Amount : number #} [ICON_Gold] of your debt.
Loan milestone reached
You reached the milestone on World Bank loan #{1_LoanID}. {2_Amount : number #} [ICON_Gold] of principal was forgiven.
Deposit matured
Deposit {1_DepositID} paid out {2_Amount : number #} [ICON_Gold]. {3_Arrears : number #} of it went to your arrears first.
Deposit withdrawn
You pulled deposit {1_DepositID} early and got {2_Amount : number #} [ICON_Gold]. {3_Arrears : number #} of it went to your arrears first.
You're World Bank President
You're the bank's biggest investor, so you get the President perks and can see everyone's debts.
No longer President
You're not the World Bank President anymore. The President perks and any President freeze have ended.
Lending freeze placed
Freeze {1_FreezeID} is on (involves player {2_PlayerID}). The frozen civ can't take new World Bank loans while it lasts.
Lending freeze lifted
Freeze {1_FreezeID} has ended, so new World Bank loans are possible again.
Disaster recovery loan offered
The World Bank offers you a recovery loan after a disaster. Claim it in the Bank panel before turn {3_Turn : number #}.
Recovery loan claimed
Your disaster recovery loan is paid out as World Bank loan #{2_LoanID}.
Recovery offer expired
You didn't claim the disaster recovery loan in time, so the offer is gone.
Development grant paid
The World Bank paid you a {2_Amount : number #} [ICON_Gold] development grant. You don't pay it back.
Development tier changed
Loan #{1_LoanID} is behind again

World Bank loan #{1_LoanID} ({2_Principal : number #} [ICON_Gold], {3_Turns : number #} turns) missed a payment again. Its earlier turns in arrears still count, so it goes into default after {4_Left : number #} more turns in arrears.
You can pay off loan #{1_LoanID}

You have enough gold to repay World Bank loan #{1_LoanID} ({2_Principal : number #} [ICON_Gold], {3_Turns : number #} turns) in full: {4_Amount : number #} [ICON_Gold]. That clears its arrears, and once no loan has arrears you're out of default and the penalties end. Use Repay early on My loans.
The World Bank now rates you {1_Tier} (was {2_OldTier}). That changes which loans you can get and on what terms.
The bank couldn't apply that, so nothing changed. Lua.log has the details.
